thread:
maya: Quick check — onboarding for customer `acme-zetta`. OTLP forwarding was enabled yesterday but dashboards/logs are empty from our side. Where should I start looking?

sam: Which tenant id / org name did they use in their forwarder?

maya: tenant_id=acme-zetta (confirmed). The envelope from their side shows remote_write -> prom-us.redwood:9090 and OTLP -> otlp-us.redwood:4317. Our collector logs show the connection accepted.

devon: Start with these quick checks:
- Grafana metrics overview: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/obs/prom-overview?var-tenant=acme-zetta (last 24h).
- Prom query to try: `rate(inference_requests_total{tenant=\"acme-zetta\"}[5m])`
- For logs: Explore -> Logs -> query `{tenant=\"acme-zetta\"}` in Loki.

tia: If logs are empty, confirm their forwarder is tagging with `tenant` label. Common issue: remote_write/scrape job not adding the label, so our routing rule drops samples. Also check their promtail/forwarder pod is actually sending lines (kubectl logs).

maya: I checked collector metrics: `received_metrics{tenant=\"acme-zetta\"} == 0` but connection looks healthy.

devon: OK that suggests our receiver got the connection but no labelled samples. Two likely causes: (1) their scrape config omitted `relabel_configs` to add tenant label, or (2) our routing rule expects `tenant` but they used `org` or `customer_id`. Ask them for the prometheus `remote_write` config snippet.

maya: Here's the snippet they sent:
```
remote_write:
  - url: "https://prom-us.redwood:9090/api/v1/write"
    basic_auth:
      username: "rw_user"
      password: "<redacted>"
# no relabel_configs here, they only scrape with job_name: node_exporter
```

sam: Ah — no relabel. That explains it. We normally expect either `relabel_configs` adding `tenant=acme-zetta` or a `write_relabel_configs` block. Without that, samples reach our prom but are not routed to the customer's tenant shard.

maya: Thanks. Quick question about traces too — they say OTLP spans are sent but Tempo search returns nothing. Where's the trace UI link?

devon: Traces live in Tempo/Jaeger UI at https://grafana.redwood.com/explore?type=traces&var-tenant=acme-zetta. If you want a direct search: https://traces.redwood.com/search?service=runtime&tenant=acme-zetta. Check collector metric `received_spans{tenant=\"acme-zetta\"}`. If that's zero, the OTLP receiver might be dropping unlabeled spans for the same reason.

tia: For alert tuning: I saw a firing alert for `runtime_high_p95_latency` for this tenant. If their traffic is low the p95 can be noisy — either lower the min-sample threshold in the alert (e.g., `>= 50` samples) or switch to p50 to reduce noise. I can draft a quick alert patch.

infra-bot: otlp-forwarder: validation run completed for tenant acme-zetta at 2026-03-10T15:12:34Z — receiver reachable, auth OK.

devon: Action items: (1) maya to ask customer to add `relabel_configs`/`write_relabel_configs` to add `tenant: acme-zetta` (2) tia to draft alert tweak for noisy p95 (3) devon will add a short doc snippet in onboarding checklist about required labels.

maya: On it — pinged their infra lead for the prom relabel snippet. Will post back once they update. :thumbsup:

tia: I already created a tiny alert PR to slack channel `#eng-sre` for review, link: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/421 (cc @devon).

devon: If anyone needs the quick one-liner for the relabel, use this in their prometheus job:
```
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
    target_label: tenant
    replacement: \"acme-zetta\"
```

maya: perfect — thanks all, will follow up once they're sending samples.
